the control theory of continuous-time systems can be extended to systems with discrete time and discrete controls, and that such an extension can be used to analyze the control of digital systems with quantized control signals.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new techniques for the control of discrete time systems with quantized control.
the control of constrained discrete-time linear systems, where the control constraints may be of two types.
the development of a new theory of constrained discrete-time linear control systems and its application to real-time optimal control.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in the case of linear systems, the theory of control of discrete time linear systems with quantized control is well understood and the results are available in the literature.
, in the context of this paper, the use of a quantizer in digital control systems is a necessary and unavoidable evil.

the results obtained in this paper provide a theoretical basis for the control of constrained discrete-time systems, and for the design of suboptimal controllers for digital systems with quantized control.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that, for a large class of constrained control systems, there exists a control law such that the state trajectories remain in a prescribed compact set.
the theory of constrained control of continuous-time linear systems is now extended to the case of digital control systems.
we have developed an algorithm that can be used to design a real-time controller, which will be optimal, or suboptimal in a sense, for any system, with any number of states, inputs, and outputs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the theory of constrained continuous time systems can be extended to the case of digital systems with quantized control inputs.
the theory of continuous time systems with control constraints can be extended to the case of discrete time systems with quantized control.
, when the system is not fully controllable, quantized controls can be used to achieve the desired behavior.
